name: Angular
certifications: No vendor certification from Google; assessed by projects
Optional: Meta or W3Cx front-end certificates for general web skills

beginner.summary: For developers who know JavaScript and are new to Angular. Covers the CLI and project set-up, components and templates, binding, control flow, signals, inputs and outputs, services and dependency injection, routing, template-driven and reactive forms, the HTTP client, pipes, directives, styling with Angular Material, RxJS, simple state, testing, lazy loading and deployment.
prerequisites: Writes modern JavaScript: modules, arrow functions, classes and promises
outcomes: Build Angular applications with standalone components, signals and the new control flow
Fetch data, handle forms and route between pages
Test, build and deploy an Angular app

days.topic: Angular Overview, CLI and Project Setup
subtopics: What Angular is and how it compares with React and Vue
Installing Node.js and the Angular CLI
Creating a project with ng new
ng serve, ng build and ng generate
VS Code extensions and Angular DevTools
The course project: a library app
days.lab_task: Create the library app with the CLI in strict mode, generate a component, run the dev server, inspect the component tree in Angular DevTools and build for production.
days.deliverable: Project in Git and notes on the main files

days.lab_task: Build header, book list and book card components, compose them into the app shell and log lifecycle hooks to see when each runs.
checks: Order of ngOnInit and ngOnDestroy explained
Style does not leak to other components

days.lab_task: Add a search box with two-way binding, buttons that mark books as favourites, conditional classes for availability and a keyboard shortcut to clear the search.
checks: Bound value updates as you type

days.lab_task: Show books with @for and track, an empty state with @empty, a status badge with @switch and a reviews section loaded with @defer when it scrolls into view.
Store the book list, search text and favourites in signals, derive the filtered list and favourite count with computed and save favourites to local storage with an effect.
checks: No signal writes inside effects without reason

days.topic: Component Communication: Inputs, Outputs and Models
subtopics: When to use a service instead
days.lab_task: Pass books into card components with required inputs, emit favourite events with outputs, build a reusable rating control with model() and a panel component with projected content.
Move book data into a service, inject it with inject(), provide an API URL with an injection token and swap the service for a fake in a test configuration.
checks: Use the service in two components

subtopics: Component input binding for route data
days.lab_task: Add list, detail and about pages, read the book ID from the route, keep filters in query parameters, add a not-found page and set page titles.
checks: Detail page shows the right book

subtopics: Form state: touched, dirty and valid
days.lab_task: Build a contact form with required, email and length validation, messages shown after the field is touched and a disabled submit button until the form is valid.
checks: Enter a bad email and leave the field

days.lab_task: Build a book editor with a typed form, a custom ISBN validator, a cross-field date rule, an async check for duplicate titles and a list of authors with FormArray.

tools: JSON Server or a mock API
days.lab_task: Load books from a REST API, show loading and error states, create and delete books, and add an interceptor that adds a header to every request.

subtopics: Built-in pipes: date, currency, number and percent
days.lab_task: Format dates, prices and percentages, set a locale, write a pipe that shortens long titles and compare it with a computed signal.
checks: Dates and currency formatted for the locale

days.lab_task: Write a highlight directive, a directive that auto-focuses inputs and a tooltip directive with inputs, and combine two with host directives.
checks: Use the tooltip with the keyboard

subtopics: Material components: buttons, forms, tables and dialogs
Responsive layouts with CSS grid and the CDK
days.lab_task: Rebuild the library UI with Angular Material: a toolbar, a sortable paginated table, form fields and a confirmation dialog, with a custom theme and a mobile layout.

subtopics: Common operators: map, filter, switchMap, debounceTime
When to use RxJS or signals
days.lab_task: Build a search-as-you-type box with debounceTime and switchMap, combine filters with combineLatest, handle errors and convert the result to a signal with toSignal.

days.topic: Sharing State with Services and Signals
subtopics: When to use a state library
days.lab_task: Create a cart service with signals for items and totals, expose read-only state, apply optimistic updates when adding items and roll back if the API fails.
checks: Write to state from a component
Compile error because state is read-only

subtopics: Test runners: Vitest and Jasmine with Karma
days.lab_task: Write tests for the book list, the editor form validation and the data service with mocked HTTP, and use a Material harness to test the table.

subtopics: Lazy loading routes with loadComponent and loadChildren
days.lab_task: Split the app into lazily loaded feature routes, add route-level providers, turn on preloading and compare initial bundle sizes before and after.

subtopics: Base href and routing on servers
Deploying to Firebase, Netlify or Azure Static Web Apps
days.lab_task: Build the app with budgets, deploy it to a static host and as an Nginx container with correct deep-link routing, and add a CI workflow that builds and tests.
checks: Open a deep link on the server

days.lab_task: Build a library app with lazy routes, signal-based state, reactive forms, API calls with loading and error states, Material UI, tests and deployment, then demo it.
days.deliverable: Repository, deployed URL, test report and demo recording
checks: Use the app on a phone
Stop the API during the demo
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one app

intermediate.summary: For developers who build Angular apps. Covers architecture, advanced signals and resources, advanced RxJS, NgRx Store and SignalStore, advanced forms, authentication with guards and interceptors, change detection and zoneless apps, SSR and hydration, internationalisation, accessibility, the CDK, end-to-end testing, HTTP caching and errors, PWAs, real-time data, Nx, CI/CD, security and upgrades.
prerequisites: Builds Angular apps with components, services, routing and forms
outcomes: Design maintainable Angular applications with clear state management
Build fast apps with SSR, deferred loading and zoneless change detection
Secure, test and internationalise production apps
Upgrade and deliver apps through CI/CD

subtopics: Feature, UI, data access and utility layers
days.lab_task: Restructure the library app into feature, UI and data access layers, add lint rules that stop UI code from importing data access and record the decisions.
days.deliverable: Restructured code, lint rules and decision records
checks: Import data access from a UI component
Presentational components have no injected services
Each decision has options and reasons

days.topic: Advanced Signals: linkedSignal, resource and Signal Forms
days.lab_task: Load book details with httpResource keyed on the route, reset a selection with linkedSignal when the list changes, and replace two effects with computed and linkedSignal.

subtopics: Higher-order mapping: switchMap, mergeMap, concatMap and exhaustMap
days.lab_task: Add polling with exponential backoff on errors, prevent double submits with exhaustMap, share a cached stream with shareReplay and test operators with marble tests.

days.topic: State Management with NgRx Store and SignalStore
subtopics: NgRx Store: actions, reducers and selectors
days.lab_task: Implement the cart with NgRx Store and with SignalStore, connect both to Redux DevTools and write guidance on when the team should use each.
checks: Add items in the Store version

days.topic: Advanced Forms: Custom Controls and Dynamic Forms
days.lab_task: Build a custom date-range control with ControlValueAccessor, a form generated from JSON configuration with conditional validation and an accessible error summary.
checks: Use the custom control in a form
Value and validity tracked by the form
Form fields change without code changes
Summary lists errors and links to fields

subtopics: OAuth 2 and OpenID Connect with PKCE
days.lab_task: Add OIDC login with PKCE, protect routes with functional guards, show admin features by role, add tokens with an interceptor and refresh them silently.
checks: Open an admin page as a normal user

days.topic: Change Detection, OnPush and Zoneless Angular
days.lab_task: Profile a slow list, switch components to OnPush with signals, enable zoneless change detection, fix the parts that break and compare render times.
days.deliverable: Profiles before and after and migration notes

days.lab_task: Add SSR to the library app, prerender the about page, use incremental hydration for reviews, fix a browser-only API error and compare Lighthouse scores.
days.deliverable: SSR app, configuration and Lighthouse reports

subtopics: Locale data for dates and numbers
days.lab_task: Translate the app into Hindi and Arabic, handle plurals, format dates and numbers per locale and fix the layout for right-to-left text.

subtopics: Testing with axe and screen readers
days.lab_task: Audit the app with axe and a screen reader, fix the issues, manage focus after navigation and announce cart changes.
days.deliverable: Audit report before and after and fixes
checks: Add to cart with a screen reader

subtopics: Building your own components on the CDK
days.lab_task: Build a custom dropdown with the overlay, a reorderable reading list with drag and drop and a virtual-scrolled list of 50,000 books.
checks: Open the dropdown near the screen edge

days.lab_task: Write Playwright tests for login, search, edit and checkout with page objects and mocked APIs, add a visual check and run them in CI.
checks: Test fails with a clear locator error
Tests pass on the CI runner

days.lab_task: Add a global error handler, an interceptor that retries safe requests and caches book lists, an offline banner and error logging to a service.
checks: Banner shown and cached data used
Fail a GET twice then succeed

days.topic: Progressive Web Apps and Service Workers
days.lab_task: Turn the app into an installable PWA with offline support for the book list, prompt users when a new version is available and pass the Lighthouse PWA checks.
checks: App opens in its own window

days.topic: Real-Time Features with WebSockets and SignalR
days.lab_task: Show live book availability from a WebSocket server, reconnect after drops, show who else is viewing a book and update signal state from events.
checks: Open the book in two browsers

days.lab_task: Move the app into an Nx workspace with feature and UI libraries, add a second admin app sharing UI code, enforce boundaries and use affected tests in CI.

tools: Firebase or Azure Static Web Apps
days.lab_task: Build a pipeline with lint, tests, build, preview deployments for pull requests and production deployment with runtime configuration and a rollback step.
Find and fix an unsafe bypassSecurityTrust call, add a strict CSP with Trusted Types, turn on XSRF protection and fix vulnerable dependencies.
days.deliverable: Fixes, CSP header and audit report
checks: Inject a script into a field

subtopics: Moving to standalone and new control flow
days.lab_task: Upgrade an Angular 15 app with NgModules to the current version step by step, run migrations to standalone, control flow and signal inputs and fix library issues.
days.deliverable: Upgraded app, change log and test results

days.lab_task: Build a customer portal with layered architecture, OIDC login, SignalStore state, SSR, i18n, accessible custom controls, real-time updates, unit and Playwright tests and a CI/CD pipeline, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repository, deployed app, test reports and presentation
checks: Tests pass and the app deploys
No serious accessibility issues and good performance scores
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one app

advanced.summary: For senior front-end developers and architects. Covers large-scale architecture, micro-frontends with Native Federation, design systems, performance engineering, signal-first architecture, rendering strategies, state at scale, library and schematic authoring, testing strategy, front-end observability, security, AI features, accessibility programmes, migrations from AngularJS, build tooling, offline-first sync, data-heavy interfaces, technical leadership and production troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Builds production Angular apps with SSR, state management and CI/CD
Writes advanced RxJS and signals code
Leads or reviews other developers' work
outcomes: Design Angular platforms for many teams and apps
Make large apps fast, accessible and secure
Build shared libraries, design systems and tools

days.lab_task: Model a banking front end with five domains owned by different teams, enforce boundaries with fitness functions in CI and present the dependency graph.
days.deliverable: Domain model, boundary rules and CI checks

days.lab_task: Split the portal into a shell and two remotes deployed separately, share Angular without duplicate copies, pass events between remotes and load a React remote.
days.deliverable: Shell, remotes, deployment configuration and notes
checks: Shell picks up the new version

days.topic: Design Systems for Angular at Scale
days.lab_task: Build a design system library with tokens, five accessible components, Storybook docs, visual regression tests and a versioned release consumed by two apps.
days.deliverable: Library, Storybook, test results and release notes
checks: Visual tests show the expected changes

subtopics: Measuring in the field and the lab
days.lab_task: Measure Core Web Vitals in the field, cut the initial bundle, optimise images, remove long tasks and enforce budgets with Lighthouse CI.
days.deliverable: Before and after measurements and CI budgets
checks: Both within good thresholds after changes

days.lab_task: Redesign a feature to be signal-first with resources at the edges and RxJS only for events, run it zoneless and write guidelines for the team.
checks: Streams converted at the edges only

days.topic: Rendering Strategies: SSR, SSG and Edge Rendering
days.lab_task: Set a rendering mode per route, cache public pages at the CDN, render one route at the edge, keep personalised pages correct and compare speed and cost.

subtopics: Server state compared with client state
days.lab_task: Separate server state with TanStack Query from client state in SignalStore, add cache invalidation across features and undo for edits.
checks: Other features show the change after invalidation

subtopics: ng add and ng update support
days.lab_task: Package the design system with secondary entry points, write an ng add schematic and an ng update migration that renames an input, and publish to a private registry.
checks: Renamed input fixed in user code

days.topic: Testing Strategy for Large Angular Codebases
subtopics: Component tests with Playwright or Cypress
days.lab_task: Write a test strategy for the portal, add component tests and a Pact contract test, find and fix three flaky tests and halve suite time.
checks: Tests pass 50 runs in a row

days.lab_task: Add error tracking, web vitals and browser tracing linked to back-end traces, mask personal data in session replay and alert on error spikes after a release.
checks: One trace from browser to API

days.lab_task: Move tokens behind a backend-for-frontend, add security headers and SRI, run ZAP in CI and block a malicious dependency with supply chain checks.
days.deliverable: BFF, headers, CI checks and threat model

subtopics: AI use cases in front ends
tools: OpenAI or Azure OpenAI through a backend
days.lab_task: Build an assistant panel that streams answers about books from a backend, shows sources, supports cancel and is accessible to screen readers.
days.deliverable: Assistant component, backend endpoint and tests
checks: Stream stops and the request is aborted

subtopics: Accessibility law: EU Accessibility Act, ADA and India's RPwD Act
days.lab_task: Write an accessibility standard for the team, add axe checks to CI, run a manual audit of three journeys and plan training and fixes.
days.deliverable: Standard, CI checks, audit and plan

days.topic: Migrating from AngularJS and Legacy Angular
days.lab_task: Run an AngularJS app and an Angular app side by side, migrate two routes to Angular with the strangler pattern and track progress on a dashboard.
days.deliverable: Hybrid app, migrated routes and progress dashboard
checks: Navigate between old and new routes

days.topic: Build Tooling: esbuild, Vite and Custom Builders
subtopics: The application builder with esbuild and Vite
days.lab_task: Move an old webpack build to the esbuild-based builder, write a custom builder that injects build information and cut CI build time with caching.
days.deliverable: Migrated build, custom builder and timings

days.lab_task: Let field users edit records offline, queue changes in IndexedDB, sync them when online and resolve a conflict between two users.
days.deliverable: Offline features, sync code and tests
checks: Edit the same record in two places

days.topic: Data-Heavy Interfaces: Grids, Charts and Large Forms
subtopics: Data grids: AG Grid and alternatives
Filtering and sorting on the server
days.lab_task: Build a grid of one million transactions with server-side rows, filters and export, a chart of daily totals and keyboard-accessible editing.
Write an RFC to move the team to signal-first state, run a review with peers, set code review standards and plan a technical debt quarter.
days.deliverable: RFC, review notes, standards and plan
checks: Feedback addressed and a decision recorded

subtopics: An incident method for front ends
days.lab_task: Diagnose five injected issues (a memory leak, a hydration mismatch, chunk load errors after deploy, an infinite change detection loop and a slow route), fix each and write a post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis notes, fixes and a post-incident review

days.lab_task: Design and build an Angular platform for three teams: micro-frontends, a design system, signal-first state, SSR, budgets, security, observability and a migration path for a legacy app, then present it to an architecture board.
days.deliverable: Architecture records, repositories, quality reports and board presentation
checks: Performance, accessibility and security checks pass
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
